subject: Intro + quick questions before demo: production traffic & timeline
messages:
From: Karl Jensen <karl@datashop.ai>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Trying Redwood – can we schedule a short demo?

Hi team,

I signed up for the hosted trial this morning and poked around the docs. Looks promising for the types of embeddings/reranking workflows we run. Our main driver is lowering latency on real-time ranking for product search while trimming costs — we have spikey traffic (peak during campaigns).

Would love a 20–30 minute walkthrough focused on:
- recommendations for serving multiple models (embed + rank) with minimal latency impact
- batching & KV cache options for bursty spikes
- pricing/estimates for ~10M tokens/month typical, spikes to ~3x

I attached a small traffic sample (anonymized) and our best-guess timeline for a pilot.

Thanks,
Karl
Karl Jensen
Head of Engineering, DataShop, Inc.
Attachments: datashop_traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Karl Jensen <karl@datashop.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:20:38 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood – can we schedule a short demo?

Hi Karl — thanks for signing up and for the traffic sample, that's super helpful. Quick clarifying questions so we tailor the demo:

1) Are the 10M tokens/month roughly evenly spread, or concentrated (e.g., 70% search, 30% background batch jobs)?
2) For the "spikes to ~3x" — how long do spikes typically last (minutes, hours, days)?
3) Do you need private deployment (VPC) or is hosted API ok for the pilot?
4) Any compliance constraints (data residency, SOC2 controls) we should mention during the call?

Assuming a short intro + tailored recommendations I can do a 25-minute slot. Here are a few times (PDT):
- Wed Aug 19, 12:00pm–12:25pm
- Wed Aug 19, 3:30pm–3:55pm
- Thu Aug 20, 9:00am–9:25am

Monica (cc) is our Solutions Engineer and will show a quick config sketch for batching/caching and walk through the cost tradeoffs.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Anna Lopez <anna@datashop.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karl Jensen <karl@datashop.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:47:50 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood – can we schedule a short demo?

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick reply. A couple quick answers:
- Tokens are mostly search traffic (~80%) with a small nightly enrichment job (~20%).
- Spikes happen in short bursts tied to promotional emails; typical spike window is 30–90 minutes, occasionally a few hours.
- Hosted API is fine for the pilot; we may need VPC for production next quarter.
- We're SOC2 compliant internally but don't require SOC2 evidence for the pilot.

The 12:00pm slot today works well for us — can you send a calendar invite? We'd like the call recorded and the config notes afterwards.

Thanks,
Anna
Product Manager, DataShop

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@datashop.ai>, Karl Jensen <karl@datashop.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:15:04 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood – can we schedule a short demo?

Great — locking in Wed Aug 19, 12:00pm–12:25pm PDT. Monica and I will run through:
- 10-minute product tour
- 10-minute tailored recommendations (batching, KV cache, model variants)
- 5-minute next steps (pilot scope + pricing estimate)

I'll send a calendar invite in a minute. We'll record and share notes + a short config snippet post-demo.

Quick note: I pulled the CSV you attached and sketched an initial throughput estimate. Can you confirm the CSV rows are representative of a single day (yes/no)? That helps our cost estimates.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Karl Jensen <karl@datashop.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Anna Lopez <anna@datashop.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:02:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood – can we schedule a short demo?

Yes — the CSV is a single day's anonymized traffic (we removed user IDs). Thanks for confirming the slot and for the estimate work. Looking forward to it.

Karl
